name: Delta SkyMiles Platinum Business American Express Card

localized_names.en: Delta SkyMiles Platinum Business American Express Card

apr.notes: 19.49% to 28.49% variable APR on purchases, per the official American Express Rates & Fees disclosure.

fx_fee.notes: No Foreign Transaction Fees — 'Use your Delta SkyMiles® Platinum Business Card globally without incurring foreign transaction fees.'

base_rate.description: 1X miles on other purchases made using the Delta SkyMiles® Platinum Business Card.

categories.label: Eligible Transit, U.S. Shipping, & Large Purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles can be used with Pay with Miles (up to $50 off per 5,000 miles on delta.com) and Take 15% Off Award Travel on Delta flights.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 70,000 bonus miles after you make $6,000 or more in eligible purchases within the first 6 months of Card Membership.

benefits.title: $120 Resy Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $120 in statement credits annually after making eligible Resy purchases on your Card. Up to $10 per month in statement credits on eligible purchases at over 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants. Enrollment Required.

benefits.title: Up to $200 Delta Stays Statement Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit of up to $200 after using your Card to book prepaid hotels or vacation rentals through Delta Stays on delta.com.

benefits.title: $120 Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $10 back in statement credits each month on U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers. Up to $120 back annually. Enrollment Required.

benefits.title: Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQD) Boost
benefits.description: Get $1 MQD for each $20 in purchases on your Card in a calendar year, getting you closer to Medallion Status for next Medallion Year quicker.

benefits.title: MQD Headstart
benefits.description: Receive $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars with MQD Headstart each Medallion Qualification Year.

benefits.title: Annual Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Receive a Companion Certificate on a Delta Main domestic, Caribbean, or Central American round-trip flight each year after renewal of your Card. Requires payment of government-imposed taxes and fees of between $22 and $250.

benefits.title: Take 15% Off Award Travel
benefits.description: Save 15% anytime you book Award Travel with miles on Delta flights when using delta.com and the Fly Delta app. Discount not applicable to partner-operated flights or to taxes and fees.

benefits.title: Complimentary Upgrade List
benefits.description: Card Members with an eligible ticket will be added to the Complimentary Upgrade list, after Delta SkyMiles Medallion Members and Reserve Card Members.

benefits.title: Check Two Bags Free
benefits.description: First checked bag flies free on international and domestic Delta flights. Second bag flies free on domestic Delta flights too.

benefits.title: Zone 5 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Board early, secure a spot for your carry-on, and enjoy plenty of time to settle in before takeoff on your next Delta flight with Zone 5 Priority Boarding.

benefits.title: Fee Credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Receive either a $120 statement credit for a Global Entry application fee or a statement credit up to $85 for a TSA PreCheck application fee every 4 years, when charged to your Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Use your Delta SkyMiles® Platinum Business Card globally without incurring foreign transaction fees.

benefits.title: Pay with Miles
benefits.description: Take up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles you redeem with Pay with Miles when you book on delta.com.

benefits.title: Hertz Five Star Status
benefits.description: Transform your car rental experience with Hertz Five Star Status, compliments of your Card. Enrollment in Hertz Gold Plus Rewards required.

benefits.title: Expanded Buying Power
benefits.description: Gives you the freedom to spend above your credit limit and get business done. The amount you can spend above your credit limit is flexible.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: Whenever you travel more than 100 miles from home, Global Assist Hotline is available for 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wires, and missing luggage assistance.

benefits.title: Employee Cards
benefits.description: Let employees buy what they need within limits you set. You'll earn miles on their purchases, and receive real-time alerts.

benefits.title: Connect to QuickBooks
benefits.description: Streamline expenses from your enrolled Business Card when your transactions are sent to your Intuit QuickBooks.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: The terms of the Original Manufacturer's Warranty can be extended up to one additional year. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less on Covered Purchases in the United States or its territories or possessions.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Can help protect Covered Purchases for up to 90 days from the Covered Purchase date if it is stolen or accidentally damaged. Coverage limited up to $1,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per Card Member account per calendar year.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: If a covered reason delays your trip more than 6 hours, can help reimburse certain additional expenses purchased on the same Eligible Card, up to $300 per trip, maximum 2 claims per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period. Coverage provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage, in excess of coverage provided by the Common Carrier. For New York State residents, $10,000 aggregate maximum limit for all Covered Persons per Covered Trip.

notes: Verified from official product page. APR not shown on page (behind Rates & Fees link). Welcome offer not displayed in page text. Rewards currency is Delta SkyMiles (not Membership Rewards).
